title: The Moral Debater: A Study on the Computational Generation of Morally Framed Arguments
reasoning: The paper focuses on Moral Foundation Theory (MFT) and explores how arguments can be computationally framed using five moral foundations (care, fairness, loyalty, authority, and purity). It evaluates the effectiveness of these morally framed arguments on audiences with different political ideologies (liberals and conservatives), which constitutes a core component of evaluating morals and value systems in an NLP context.
